# POL-01 — Example Builders Operating Policy (fictional, for tests)

## Rules

### 1. AUTH-WRITTEN — Written authorization before work

Example Builders starts changed work only after the client signs the potential change order and the Executive co-signs it.

### 2. BILL-SUPPORTED — Bill only what you can support

A change is billed only after the prime contract change order is executed.

### 3. APPROVAL-SPEND — Spending approval limits

Subcontract commitments over the PM's limit need the Executive's approval.
